operation_details.item: Earlier, the user's recommendation was to insource the logistics function.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, just wrapped the final client report. Feels good to finally have it done.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice! How did the logistics recommendation end up landing? I remember you were going back and forth on that one.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, earlier I was leaning toward insourcing, but after the updated cost model, I switched to recommending outsourcing. It made way more sense in the end.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's a pretty big shift. What did the cost model show that changed your mind?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The numbers showed outsourcing is going to be cheaper over the next few years, especially with the variable volume. So the final report now has the outsourcing recommendation solidly in there.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. Good thing you updated it before the deadline — that could have been awkward.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Definitely. The client seemed happy with the clarity, so I think we're all set here.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great work. Let me know if you need any help with the presentation for them.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier insourcing recommendation and retain the current outsourcing recommendation and rationale.
